links.comparator_used: Static logistic regression prediction model (original) trained once and not updated
links.outcome: Predictive performance (calibration, discrimination, clinical net benefit) for predicting psychosis onset at 1 year in UHR individuals
links.effect: All 3 updating methods improved performance vs the original model (recalibration p = .009; refitting p = .020; dynamic updating p = .001). Dynamic updating performed best: Harrell's C-index 0.71 (95% CI 0.60 to 0.82), calibration slope 1.12 (95% CI 0.46 to 1.87), and best clinical net benefit over the validation period. The original model was poorly calibrated throughout.
links.quote: All 3 updating methods improved the predictive performance compared with the original model (recalibration: p = .009; refitting: p = .020; dynamic updating: p = .001).
